definitions.explanation: the bumpy texture of skin caused by cold or strong emotions

examples.japanese: ⟦{寒|さむ}くて→寒い：00664_samui⟧{鳥肌|とりはだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: I got goosebumps from the cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{感動|かんどう}して→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧{鳥肌|とりはだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}った→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧。
examples.english: I got goosebumps from being moved.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{歌|うた}→歌：02179_uta⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{聞|き}く→聞く：00483_kiku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{鳥肌|とりはだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ほど⟦{感動|かんどう}する→感動する：21603_kandousuru⟧。
examples.english: That song is so moving it gives me goosebumps.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
{鳥肌|とりはだ} literally means "bird skin" (⟦{鳥|とり}→鳥：00679_tori⟧ = bird, ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ = skin), referring to the appearance of plucked poultry.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {鳥肌|とりはだ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧ - to get goosebumps (the standard collocation)
- {鳥肌|とりはだ}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ - something that gives you goosebumps (often describing something amazing or creepy)

CAUSES:
{鳥肌|とりはだ} can be caused by:
- Cold temperatures (⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧)
- Fear (⟦{恐怖|きょうふ}→恐怖：02585_kyoufu⟧)
- Emotional experiences (⟦{感動|かんどう}→感動：00167_kandou⟧)
- Creepy or eerie situations (⟦{気味|きみ}が{悪|わる}い→気味が悪い：22680_kimigawarui⟧)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{身震|みぶる}い→身震い：14288_miburui⟧ - shiver, shudder
- ⟦{寒気|さむけ}→寒気：16081_samuke⟧ - chills
